answer: Here is one mechanism that works: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because delta only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, haven is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any velvet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
